description: Dept. of Fiscal Policy - Order declaring Excise Duty on Waters, Beverages
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the amendment of excise duty rates through a statutory order issued under the Excise (Special Provisions) Act. It involves regulatory changes to tax rates on specific goods (beverages), making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change. The mention of Minister Mahinda Rajapaksa is incidental to the regulatory action being taken.
